subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should this browser contract require every backend to return an operation-owned target outcome, rather than allowing the shared resolver to infer a replacement from a post-operation tab list?
rationale: The contributor explicitly requested direction between the narrower heuristic and the backend-owned design, and the existing route-level heuristic leaves the two P1 wrong-target cases unresolved.

options.title: Adopt backend-owned target outcomes
options.body: Require managed Playwright, extension relay, and Chrome MCP paths to return their exact selected target or a closed/stale result, then remove route-level identity discovery.

options.title: Approve a bounded heuristic contract
options.body: Accept replacement inference only for explicitly named backends and document the remaining ambiguity and test matrix before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt backend-owned target outcomes
recommendation.body: Require managed Playwright, extension relay, and Chrome MCP paths to return their exact selected target or a closed/stale result, then remove route-level identity discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical report defines the proposed cross-backend contract and its required regression matrix.
